correctness.rationale: The invariant-face factorization is exact. On A=0 the equilibrium equations reduce to one scalar equation F_beta(E)=lambda. I(E) and F_beta(E) are strictly increasing, giving an if-and-only-if branch criterion. The antibody eigenvalue follows from the triangular Jacobian row at A=0. The finite beta_A formula is obtained by substituting the unique viral-load crossing into the same exact equilibrium identity. All boundary cases beta=beta_c and lambda<=D_A I_A are stated explicitly. The bundled checker reproduces the equilibrium residuals and threshold sign change.

value.rationale: The result repairs the equilibrium geometry of a current HPV model rather than adding a cosmetic variant. It supplies an exact, biologically interpretable distinction between viral invasion and humoral invasion, identifies when antibodies can grow from rarity, and explains why q and omega cannot alter the disease-free next-generation threshold. This directly changes how the model's equilibrium census, global boundary statement, and sensitivity interpretation should be read.
